toolOutage.scope: WebFetch in this routine's cloud sandbox resolves only the www.anthropic.com apex. Every other domain tested fails DNS resolution (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) — job boards (greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com, lever.co), company sites (databricks.com), government (nsf.gov), and general web (ycombinator.com). This includes Anthropic's own job-detail pages, which live on job-boards.greenhouse.io and are therefore also unreachable even though anthropic.com itself is fine. WebSearch is on a separate, unaffected backend and still works, but its results can't be verified by fetching the source page, so per the routine's honesty rules nothing from it can be included.
toolOutage.persistence: Confirmed present again today, 2026-10-15, identical in shape to every prior day's report going back to mid-July 2026 — now over 3 months unresolved despite being reported in the searchLog every single day.
toolOutage.likelyImpact: Zero opportunities can be verified from any company's actual careers/application page except Anthropic's top-level listing (which has no usable new-grad roles for Dom's target families and whose individual postings are unreachable anyway). This has been the actual cause of the 3-month run of zero verified opportunities, not a lack of real leads.
toolOutage.fix: This is an environment/network-policy (egress allowlist) setting for the life-hub-daily / hunt routine's cloud sandbox, not something fixable from inside the session. It needs widening to at least standard job-board domains (greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com, lever.co, myworkday.com, workable.com) plus the specific company domains in data/target-companies.json. Worth checking the routine's network policy / connector settings directly — three months of daily reports haven't self-resolved it, and this gap has never been written into the life hub's TODO.md or LOG.md, so it may not be on Dom's radar as a standing issue to fix rather than a transient blip.
